scenes.title: MMPC Tundish Water-Modelling Bay
scenes.institution: McGill Metals Processing Centre — Water Modelling Laboratory
scenes.reference_notes: Official facility photograph shows a transparent full-scale tundish water model with bolted steel frame, elevated feed hardware and instrumentation. The official page explicitly reserves all rights. Photo is a local reference only; no CAD, measured room plan or calibrated dimensions were found.
observed_cues: Black bolted perimeter members subdivide large transparent tank windows.
Feed assembly and access structure are elevated above the long tank.
Grating floor, hanging sensor leads and foreground measurement station define the service side.
scenes.reconstruction_scope: Reconstruct the photographed apparatus and service-side bay; the complete room footprint and hidden tank plan are unverified.

task.observable: feed_nozzle_height, probe_traverse, calibration_target and feed_nozzle poses.

limitations: All tank, pipe, frame and room dimensions are estimated from one front-side photograph.

The transparent vessel is dry; no water transport, mixing, residence-time response, metallurgical or casting model.
